# CLI and Package Manager (`edva.ccl`)

The `edva` binary provides single-file / modular compilation, interactive REPL and inline evaluation (`-i`, `-e`), AST/type inspection, canonical code formatting (`edva fmt`), Language Server Protocol support (`edva lsp`), and top-level package management (`edva init`, `edva add`, `edva rm`, `edva build`, `edva run`, `edva test`, `edva fetch`, `edva update`, `edva tree`, `edva vendor`, `edva cache`).

## Compiler invocation and options

```sh
edva [options] [input.dva | dir] [output]
edva <command> [options] [args...]
edva -e "<code_string>" [options]
edva -i
edva fmt [--check] [--stdout] [--stdin] [path...]
edva lsp
```

| Short / Long Option | Argument | Default | Specification |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` | `<str>` | `<stem>` | Output binary, `.o` object, `.so` shared library, `.wasm`, or `.ll` path |
| `-r`, `--run` | — | `<->` | Run compiled binary immediately after linking (uses `node` for `.wasm` targets) |
| `--ir` | — | `<->` | Emit LLVM IR (`.ll`) only; do not invoke `clang` |
| `-c`, `--compile-only` | — | `<->` | Compile module to object file (`.o`) only (implies `--no-main`) |
| `--shared` | — | `<->` | Build a shared library (`.so`, implies `--no-main`) |
| `--entry` | — | `<->` | Compile as program entry module (emits `main`) |
| `-m`, `--module` | `<str>` | `""` | Compile as named module `<str>` (implies `-c` and `--no-main`) |
| `-t`, `--target` | `<str>` | Host triple | Target triple (e.g. `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-linux-gnu`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `wasm32-wasi`) |
| `-O`, `--opt` | `<str>` | `"2"` | Optimization level (`0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `s`, `z`, or `-O0`..`-Oz`) |
| `-H`, `--header` | `<str>` | `""` | Generate C header file at `<str>` from `#export` declarations |
| `-e`, `--eval` | `<str>` | `""` | Compile and evaluate inline Edva code string (auto-prints single non-unit expressions) |
| `-i`, `--repl` | — | `<->` | Start interactive terminal REPL (`:q`, `:quit`, `exit`, or `Ctrl-D` to exit) |
| `--ast` | — | `<->` | Print parsed AST of target program and exit |
| `--ast-tree` | — | `<->` | Print parsed AST as an indented tree and exit |
| `--typed-ast` | — | `<->` | Elaborate and verify typed AST, print elaboration stats, and exit |
| `--typed-ast-tree` | — | `<->` | Elaborate, verify, and dump typed AST tree |
| `--no-main` | — | `<->` | Emit `main` with internal linkage |
| `--no-runtime` | — | `<->` | Omit standard runtime emission |
| `--import-map` | `<str>` | `""` | Path to package import map (`.edva/imports.ccl`) |
| `--cache` | `<str>` | `~/.cache/edva/ir` | Compilation cache directory path |
| `--no-cache` | — | `<->` | Disable compilation cache |
| `--cflag` | `<str>` | `()` | Pass additional flag to `clang` (repeatable, e.g. `--cflag -lm --cflag -msimd128`) |
| `-v`, `--version` | — | — | Display compiler version (`edva <version>`) and exit |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | Display formatted CLI help and exit |

### Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `EDVA_PATH` / `EDVA_STDLIB` | `<exe_dir>/std` | Overrides standard library directory resolution |
| `XDG_CACHE_HOME` | `~/.cache` | Base directory for compilation cache (`edva/ir`) and package store (`edva/store`) |
| `EDVA_STORE` | `~/.cache/edva/store` | Content-addressed package store directory |
| `EDVA_OFFLINE` | `"0"` | Set to `"1"` to enforce `--offline` mode across package commands |
| `EDVA_NO_CACHE` | `"0"` | Set to `"1"` to disable IR caching across compiler and package commands |
| `EDVA_GIT` | `"git"` | Git executable used when fetching git dependencies |

## Package and cache subcommands

All package and cache commands are first-class top-level subcommands (`edva <command> --help` shows command-scoped help):

| Command | Arguments & Options | Behavior | Diagnostics |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edva init` | `[dir] [-n/--name <name>] [--lib]` | Scaffolds `edva.ccl`, `src/<name>.dva`, and (unless `--lib`) `src/main.dva` in `[dir]` (default: `.`) | `E7020`: `edva.ccl` already exists |
| `edva add` | `[<alias>] <spec> [--as <alias>] [--rev <r>]`<br>`[<alias>] --path <p>`<br>`[<alias>] --git <url> [--rev <r>]`<br>`[<alias>] --url <u> --hash <h>` | Transactionally adds dependency to `edva.ccl` (auto-inferring alias from `edva.ccl` `name` or repo/dir basename when omitted, supporting `<spec>@<rev>`, `owner/repo`, and `host/owner/repo` shorthand), resolves graph, and updates `edva.lock.ccl` (rolls back `edva.ccl` on failure) | `E7021`: rollback on fetch/resolve failure |
| `edva rm` | `<alias> [dir]` (alias `remove`) | Removes `<alias>` from `edva.ccl` and updates `edva.lock.ccl` and `.edva/imports.ccl` | `E7004`: dependency not found |
| `edva build` | `[dir \| file.dva] [-o <out>] [-t <triple>] [-O <opt>] [--cflag <f>] [--locked] [--offline] [--store <d>] [--cache <d>] [--no-cache]` | Dual-mode: builds package targets from `edva.ccl` (or `src/main.dva` $\to$ `./<name>`) or compiles a single `.dva` file | `E5039`: missing `pkg-config` lib |
| `edva run` | `[dir \| file.dva] [options] [-- <args...>]` | Dual-mode: builds and executes the package binary or single `.dva` file, forwarding arguments after `--` to the program | `E7019`: missing source or target |
| `edva test` | `[dir \| file.dva] [--locked] [--offline] [--store <d>] [--cache <d>] [--no-cache]` | Compiles and runs all `tests/*.dva` in a package, or a single test `.dva` file if specified | — |
| `edva fetch` | `[dir] [--locked] [--offline] [--store <d>] [--cache <d>] [--no-cache]` | Resolves dependencies, populates content store, writes `edva.lock.ccl` and `.edva/imports.ccl` | `E7007`: lockfile out of date (`--locked`) |
| `edva update` | `[pkg_name] [dir]` | Refreshes moving Git branches/tags in `edva.lock.ccl` (all or single `<pkg_name>`) | — |
| `edva tree` | `[dir]` (alias `graph`) | Prints ASCII dependency tree with provenance, duplicate versions, and cycle checks | — |
| `edva vendor` | `[dir]` | Materializes external dependencies into `vendor/<id>/` + `vendor/vendor.ccl` for air-gapped `--offline --locked` builds | `E7005`: tree hash mismatch |
| `edva cache` | `[dir \| ls \| clean] [--cache <d>]` | Prints cache directory (default), lists cached `.ll` entries, or cleans cached IR artifacts | — |

## Formatter and Language Server (`edva fmt`, `edva lsp`)

| Command | Arguments & Options | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `edva fmt` | `[--check] [--stdout] [--stdin] [path...]` | Canonical Edva source formatter. Normalizes block indentation, delimiter spacing, blank lines, and trailing whitespace while preserving intentional horizontal alignment and verifying AST equivalence via `show::show_expr`. Formats `.` recursively when no paths are given. `--check` exits `1` if any file differs; `--stdin` formats stdin to stdout |
| `edva lsp` | — | JSON-RPC 2.0 Language Server Protocol server over stdio (`Content-Length` framing). Provides live diagnostics (`textDocument/publishDiagnostics`), inferred-type hover (`textDocument/hover`), same-file and cross-module go-to-definition (`textDocument/definition`), document symbols (`textDocument/documentSymbol`), completion (`textDocument/completion`), and canonical formatting (`textDocument/formatting`) |

### `edva fmt` formatting rules

| Rule | Construct | Indentation / Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| **Standard blocks (`+3` spaces)** | Function/lambda bodies (`=>`, `!=>`, `| x =>`), cycle bodies (`@`, `@@`, `>--`), `[guard]` arm bodies, choice arms relative to the choice head, and `#type` / `#foreign` / `#public` / `#private` blocks | Indented by **`+3` spaces** relative to the enclosing statement or inline-started block opener (`my_fn = a, b => first_line` followed by `second_line` at `+3` spaces) |
| **Inline choice arm bodies (`+2` spaces)** | Choice arm starting on the same line as `|` or `!|` (`| first_line`) | Subsequent statements of the arm block indent by **`+2` spaces** relative to `|`, aligning directly under `first_line` |
| **Expression continuations (`+2` spaces)** | Multi-line expressions wrapped after a trailing binary or continuation operator (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `&&`, `||`, `,`, `$`, etc.) | Indented by **`+2` spaces** relative to the statement's starting column |
| **Horizontal alignment** | Multi-space column alignment in `[guard]` tables, `#type` / `#foreign` declarations, and inline comments | Preserved intact |

## Package directory layout and `edva.ccl` manifest schema

### Standard package layout

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `edva.ccl` | Package manifest (name, version, dependencies, native libs, build targets) |
| `edva.lock.ccl` | Deterministic lockfile pinning commit hashes and canonical `sha256-<hex>` tree digests |
| `.edva/imports.ccl` | Generated import map linking `@alias` imports (`#use @pkg`) to resolved store/vendor paths |
| `src/<name>.dva` | Root library module imported when dependents write `#use @<name>` |
| `src/main.dva` | Default executable entry point when `targets =` is omitted |
| `tests/*.dva` | Independent test executables discovered by `edva test` |

### `edva.ccl` configuration keys

The manifest uses CCL (Categorical Configuration Language) syntax (`key = value` with indentation-scoped sections):

| Section / Key | Example | Specification |
|---|---|---|
| `name`, `version`, `edva` | `name = my_app` | Package identifier, semantic version, and minimum compiler version |
| `dependencies.<alias>.path` | `path = ../math_utils` | Local relative or absolute directory containing `edva.ccl` |
| `dependencies.<alias>.git` / `rev` | `git = https://...`<br>`rev = v1.2.0` | Git repository URL and branch, tag, or commit (pinned with tree hash in `edva.lock.ccl`) |
| `dependencies.<alias>.url` / `hash` | `url = https://.../a.tar.gz`<br>`hash = sha256-<hex>` | Tarball archive verified against `sha256-<hex>` digest |
| `overrides.<alias>` | `path = ../local_fork` | Root-manifest override replacing direct or transitive dependency `<alias>` across the graph |
| `native.libs` | `= m`<br>`= pthread` | List of system libraries forwarded as `-l<lib>` to Clang |
| `native.pkg-config` | `= libssl` | List of packages resolved via `pkg-config --libs <name>` (`E5039` if missing on host) |
| `targets.<id>.src` | `src = src/client.dva` | Entry `.dva` source file for build target `<id>` (default: `src/main.dva`) |
| `targets.<id>.out` | `out = dist/client.wasm` | Output binary path for build target `<id>` (default: `<id>`) |
| `targets.<id>.target` | `target = wasm32-unknown-unknown` | Target triple passed via `-t` / `--target` |
| `targets.<id>.opt` | `opt = -O3` | Optimization level (`0`..`3`, `s`, `z`, or `-O0`..`-O3`) |
| `targets.<id>.cflags` | `= -msimd128` | List or space-separated string of flags forwarded via `--cflag` |

```{.dva .partial}
// Importing external packages declared in edva.ccl:
#use @term
#use @term/colors

term::print("ok")
```
